name: TalkAM API
description: TalkAM's backend API — a Laravel app serving a mental-wellness/community platform: 1:1 messaging, therapy session booking and lifecycle, therapist onboarding/earnings, a B2B 'TalkAM for Business' org portal, a community/social feed, and a staff Platform Admin console. Two concurrent API generations are live: /api/v1 (legacy, still mounted, partially superseded) and /api/v2 (actively developed). This catalog reflects the route surface as registered in routes/api_v1.php and routes/api_v2.php, mapped 2026-09-29.
x-notes: baseURL values use https://staging.talkam.net as the confirmed-live host observed during this investigation. Production may serve the API from a different host (e.g. api.talkam.net) — update baseURL accordingly once confirmed. No formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec exists yet for either version; x-controller/x-auth/x-approx-routes are extensions added here (not part of the base APIs.json spec) to keep this catalog useful standalone. x-endpoints (optional, added per entry as endpoints are documented) lists individual method/path/summary rows relative to baseURL. Each x-endpoints row carries an x-request: contentType, body (field -> rules) and a JSON example, plus pathParams where the path has placeholders. All requests also need the Authorization: Bearer <sanctum token> header and Accept: application/json. x-response lists the success body and the error cases per endpoint. Every response uses the envelope {message, data, success, code}; errors add error_code and, for validation (422), an errors map. In local/staging environments the error message is the raw exception message and error_debug carries a stack trace. Rows whose x-response.success.body is null document routes that are registered but cannot succeed today.

apis.name: Platform Admin: Wellness Nudges (v2)
apis.description: Admin-managed pool of texts for the daily wellness check-in push/mail/in-app nudge. Each night's nudge (wellness:send-checkin-nudges, sent to users with no mood check-in that day, once a day, at V2_WELLNESS_NUDGE_HOUR, honoring the wellness_nudges preference) picks one ACTIVE message at random per user; if the pool has no active message it falls back to the original fixed text. Full CRUD (list, create, edit/activate/deactivate, delete) is open to Super Admin, Admin and Content Manager; Support Staff and regular users get 403. The scheduler runs the command hourly and it sends only in the configured hour, so each user gets at most one nudge per day, using whatever is active in the pool at that moment.
